normative_extracts.quote: When a classic script element is encountered without async or defer, the HTML parser pauses until any pending style sheets finish loading and the script executes.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: HTML and CSS parsers run separate state machines; synchronous scripts serialize them because JS can query computed styles.

production_failures.symptom: Blank white screen for 2+ seconds on initial navigation despite tiny HTML payload
production_failures.root_cause: A synchronous <script> tag placed after a large external <link rel="stylesheet"> blocks HTML parsing until the stylesheet downloads and parses.
production_failures.mitigation: Add defer to scripts, inline critical CSS, and split non-critical stylesheets with media attributes.

production_failures.symptom: Unstyled content flash (FOUC) followed by jarring layout shift
production_failures.root_cause: Stylesheets loaded dynamically via JavaScript bypass render-blocking heuristics and arrive after first paint.
production_failures.mitigation: Declare critical stylesheets statically in <head> so CSSOM blocks first paint intentionally.
